$comment: Read by the kaas-eng plugin hooks (Param-Harrison/lwp-claude-plugins). The ruff pin matches the sessions' pyproject.toml, so an edit formats as each session's gate checks.
name: agentic-ai-lightning-sessions
$stageGates: push matches stop so the scanners run before every push, not the gate alone; CI runs the same scan.

checks.name: session
checks.run: for d in evals-from-traces governance guardrails mission-control multi-agent-mcp second-brain token-economics trace-in-production; do make -C $d check || exit 1; done
checks.scoped: for d in {items}; do make -C $d check || exit 1; done
covers: mkdir -p reports; for d in $(BUILT); do echo "== $$d";  	  PYTEST_ADDOPTS="-k 'not quarantine' --junitxml=$(CURDIR)/reports/$$d.xml" $(MAKE) -C $$d check || exit 1; done
